_comment: HMS (Health Management System) code descriptions, keyed by the full 16-hex identifier `f"{attr:08X}{code:08X}"` from the printer's `hms[]` array. This is a DIFFERENT code family from hms_actions.json / HMS_ERROR_DESCRIPTIONS, which are keyed by the 8-hex `print_error` short code — the two sets do not overlap, so hms[] faults previously had no description source at all.
_source: wiki.bambulab.com/en/hms/home English code pages, with gaps filled from Bambu's e.bambulab.com/query.php?lang=en error-string API; a small number were translated from the Chinese pages. Per-entry provenance is in the "s" field (wiki | api | translated).
_schema: codes[<16-hex>] = [ {d: description, m: [normalised model names], s: source}, ... ] — multiple entries mean the wording is printer-specific; match on `m`, else use the first (widest applicability).
